name: Anand Seamless Limited
about: Anand Seamless Limited operates as a tubes and pipes manufacturer and exporter in India. The company's products include Seamless tubes and pipes, and Finned tubes. It manufactures a wide range of Seamless Pipes and Tubes, such as Straight Tubes and Pipes and U- Bend Tubes. Its straight tubes and pipes include Carbon Steel Seamless Straight Tubes and Pipes, Alloy Steel Seamless Tubes and Pipes, and Stainless-Steel Seamless Tubes and Pipes. It also offers Alloy Steel Seamless U- Bend Tubes and Carbon Steel Seamless U-Bend Tubes. Additionally, the company manufactures various types of Finned Tubes, such as extruded fin tube, low fin tube, embedded fin tube or g' fin tube, l' type fin tubes, welded fin tube, crimped fin tube, and studded fin tube. Its are used by a diverse range of industries including automobile industries, heat exchanger industry, petroleum industries, pharmaceutical industries, chemical industries, oil and gas refineries, thermal & nuclear power plants, boiler manufacturing, chemical industries, textile machinery, railways and transportation sectors, and the defense sector. The company was formerly known as Anand Seamless Tubes Limited and changed its name to Anand Seamless Limited in December 2023. Anand Seamless Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Kadi, India.
